name: KB Home
summary:
KB Home (KBH) reported earnings of $1.05 per share on revenue of $1.30 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.88 per share on revenue of $1.29 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.85 per share. The company beat expectations by 23.53% while revenue fell 19.96% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects fourth quarter revenue of $1.45 billion to $1.65 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $1.59 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

KB Home is one of the largest and most recognized homebuilders in the United States and has built over 650,000 quality homes in our more than 60-year history.
subject: KB Home Beat Expectations

name: Worthington Enterprises, Inc.

subject: Worthington Enterprises Beat Consensus Estimates

name: MillerKnoll, Inc.
summary:
MillerKnoll, Inc. (MLKN) reported earnings of $0.53 per share on revenue of $923.40 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.35 per share on revenue of $942.70 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.37 per share. The company beat expectations by 43.24% while revenue fell 3.38% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects second-quarter earnings of $0.43 to $0.49 per share on revenue of $972.0 million to $1.012 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $0.46 per share on revenue of $1.02 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026. The company also said it continues to expect fiscal 2027 earnings of $1.85 to $2.15 per share but now expects revenue of $3.88 billion to $4.03 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $3.93 billion to $4.13 billion, and the current consensus earnings estimate is $2.02 per share on revenue of $4.01 billion for the year ending May 31, 2027.

MillerKnoll is a collective of dynamic brands and one of the largest and most influential modern design companies in the world.
subject: MillerKnoll, Inc. Beat Expectations
